jobs.occupation: Field Sales Manager - Belgium and the Netherlands
jobs.description:
Introduction
 

At Ekwip, our goal is simple: 
help local retail thrive internationally.
 

A sports shop in Namur, a bookshop in Ghent or a pet store in Rotterdam may have 
20–40% of its inventory sitting unsold, tying up cash and losing value. Ekwip takes care of this stock from end to end and sells it online across Europe through major marketplaces.
 

Retailers keep their store, identity and existing operations without having to become e-commerce experts.
 

The model is proven: steady monthly growth, no customer churn since launch and partnerships underway with major distributors. After a strong start in French-speaking Belgium, Ekwip is now expanding into Flanders and the Netherlands.
 

The pitch takes 90 seconds and the sales cycle is measured in days, not quarters. With 
more than 150,000 independent retailers across Europe, the opportunity is to sign hundreds of customers every year.
 

About the Role
 

You will lead 
business development from A to Z, working directly with Ekwip’s three co-founders.
 

Independent and specialised retailers
 
 

• Identify and target retailers in sports, fashion, footwear, pet care, home, toys and books 

• Build your own pipeline through cold calling, store visits, networking and trade fairs 

• Manage qualification, negotiation and closing 

• Organise your prospecting by region with a strong focus on efficiency and results  

Distributors and industrial wholesalers
 
 

• Identify the most relevant partners 

• Define the right approach and activate new opportunities 

• Lead negotiations and close strategic agreements 

• Develop partnerships where 
one agreement can unlock an entire network of stores  

Market insights and performance
 
 

• Act as Ekwip’s eyes and ears in the market 

• Share customer needs, recurring objections and local market practices 

• Feed insights directly into the product roadmap 

• Continuously manage your pipeline and performance  

Growth opportunities
 

Ekwip’s medium-term ambition is to build a commercial team in each country, with Business Developers and Account Managers.
 

You will be the first building block of this structure. 
Strong performance can lead to a management role, where you will recruit, train and lead your own local sales team.
 

Your Profile
 
 

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Sales or a related field 

• Fluent Dutch is essential, as this is the main market to develop; French and English are needed 

• A successful first experience in B2B sales, with proven results 

• Valid driving licence  

What we are looking for
 
 

• A true hunter mindset: you are comfortable with cold outreach and know how to build a pipeline from scratch 

• Strong autonomy: you manage your territory like your own business 

• Genuine curiosity for retail: you listen as much as you sell 

• A structured and methodical approach to pipeline management 

• The motivation to build in a fast-paced, demanding and pragmatic environment 

• Experience in retail, SaaS or marketplaces is a strong advantage

You coordinate and supervise the food, team & workload from our central prep kitchen, which supplies to outlets in multiple sites around Brussel
 
 

• Work and manage bulk production, cooking, packing & finishing. 

• Handle orders from each outlet. 

• Place orders with multiple suppliers. 

• Manage stocks and inventory. 

• Plan daily, weekly & monthly workload. 

• Co-ordinate workload between day kitchen and evening shift. 

• Maintain a clean workspace and take care of kitchen tools. 

• Respect safety standards during the work. 

• Label and store all food according to HACCP standards. 

• Receive and check goods received. 

• Collaborate with the rest of the (culinary) team to ensure high-quality food and service for North Indian, South Indian and sweets 
 

• Min 5 year experience as a chef 

• Experience in Managing multiple outlets with Experience in similar positions. 

• Knowledge of Indian Cuisine is a must. 

• Good level of English/Hindi both spoken & written 

• Able to follow and execute under instruction & good in communication. 

• Team player & trouble-shooter 

• Knowledge of HACCP 

• Able to multitask and work efficiently under pressure.

Are you an expert in elevator technology with a passion for troubleshooting? Do you enjoy working independently and managing your own service route? We are looking for an experienced Service Technician (Elevators) to join our professional team in the East and West Flanders regions.

• Education: A technical degree in Electromechanics, Electricity, or Maintenance Technology (or equivalent through experience).
• Independence: Ability to work autonomously "on the road" with a strong sense of responsibility.
• Languages: Fluent in English and/or Dutch.

Profile

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, you will be involved in the complete development of innovative machines and testing systems. From the initial concept to the final installation at the customer's site, you will play an active role throughout the entire project lifecycle. This is a varied position combining engineering, assembly, testing and international commissioning.

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, your responsibilities include:

• Developing and improving new machines and technical solutions.
• Building, assembling and testing prototypes.
• Installing, commissioning and fine-tuning equipment at customer sites both nationally and internationally.
• Analysing technical issues and proposing improvements to products and processes.
• Preparing technical documentation, manuals and work instructions.
• Collaborating closely with colleagues from engineering, production and service departments.
• Providing technical support during demonstrations, trade fairs and commercial activities.

For this positFor this position as Project Engineer Machine Building, we are looking for an all-round engineer who enjoys combining theory with hands-on technical work. You like taking ownership of projects from start to finish and are willing to travel internationally on a regular basis.

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, you have:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electromechanics, Mechanical Engineering, Product Development, Machine Building or a related technical field.
• A strong interest in machine building, automation and product development.
• A hands-on mentality and practical approach to engineering.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Willingness to travel internationally for installations and commissioning projects.

• Knowledge of Dutch is mandatory.

Your responsibilities 
 

You will provide comprehensive administrative and organisational support to our lawyers.
 

Your responsibilities will include:
 

Matter and document support: opening and maintaining matters in the ERP system; preparing court documents; finalising submissions; monitoring deadlines; ensuring consistent document formatting. Financial administration: preparing and following up invoices; creating purchase requisitions and purchase orders; processing expense reports. Planning and logistics: managing calendars; organising internal and external meetings; arranging travel; coordinating hearing-related logistics. Data and compliance: maintaining CRM records and monitoring lawyers’ professional or bar-related obligations.

Essential
 

At least two years’ experience in an administrative, executive assistant or management assistant role. Excellent written and spoken Dutch and English. Proficiency in Microsoft Office. Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities.  Desirable
 

Previous experience in a law firm or another professional-services environment. Working knowledge of French. Experience with ERP, document management or CRM systems.

About Fluves
 

Fluves is a pioneer in fiber-optic sensing, combining advanced DTS and DAS technology, real-time data processing and smart analytics to monitor and protect critical infrastructure.
 

Through its Marlinks product line, Fluves monitors more than 1,800 km of subsea power cables connecting offshore wind farms and power grids. The DALI product line detects leaks and intrusions in water networks, while Fluves Corrosion assesses the risk of corrosion under insulation in chemical plants.
 

Based in Ghent, Fluves is a growing technology scale-up active in critical infrastructure markets around the world.
 

 
 

Your role
 

As Field & Operations Technician, you will be part of the Fluves delivery team. You will support the practical and technical execution of customer projects, both on-site and from our Ghent office.
 

You will prepare, execute, verify and document the installation of fiber-optic cables and electronic equipment at locations in Belgium and neighbouring countries. You will work closely with project managers, technical experts, subcontractors and customers to ensure that delivery work is carried out safely, reliably and in accordance with Fluves’ quality standards.
 

This is a hands-on role for someone who is independent, responsible, customer-oriented and well organized.
 

 
 

What you will do
 
 

• Prepare and support fiber installations based on customer information, technical drawings and internal requirements. 

 

• Brief subcontractors before work starts, provide practical guidance during installation, and inspect and document the quality of the completed work. 

 

• Splice fiber-optic cables and repair damaged cables. 

 

• Record installed fiber routes and maintain accurate project documentation. 

 

• Prepare, test and configure equipment before shipment or installation. 

 

• Mount devices and prepare hardware for customer projects. 

 

• Prepare shipments and ensure that project materials are complete, correctly packed and properly documented. 

 

• Maintain and organize the Fluves warehouse, including equipment, tools, test setups and project materials. 

 

• Support project managers with practical technical tasks before, during and after project execution. 

 

• Communicate clearly and professionally with customers, subcontractors and colleagues. 

 

• Help ensure that installations, equipment and project documentation meet Fluves’ quality standards. 

 

• Follow all applicable safety procedures, identify and report hazards, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our working methods. 

 

• Act as Fluves’ operational lead on site and help ensure that Fluves personnel and subcontractors work in accordance with our safety and quality standards. 

Who you are
 
 

• You have a solid practical technical background, ideally through a technical bachelor’s degree, graduate degree or equivalent relevant experience. 

 

• You are hands-on and comfortable working with technical equipment, power tools, cabling, racks, sensors and electrical components. 

 

• You work carefully and have a strong eye for detail, particularly when documenting installations, inspecting work or preparing equipment for customer projects. 

 

• You have a strong safety mindset and are willing to obtain the necessary safety certificates and training. 

 

• You are responsible, reliable and well organized. When you take on a task, others can trust that you will follow it through properly. 

 

• You can work independently and adapt to unforeseen situations in the field, while knowing when to ask for support or clarification. 

 

• You communicate clearly and professionally with customers, subcontractors and colleagues. 

 

• You are comfortable working both on-site in industrial environments and in an office or warehouse environment. 

 

• You have a valid category B driving license and are willing to travel occasionally for customer projects, mainly within Belgium and neighbouring countries. 

 

• You are fluent in English. Knowledge of Dutch or French is an advantage. 

 

• You have a good working knowledge of standard office software, such as Excel, Word and Outlook, and are willing to learn to use specialized software packages. 

 

• Experience with AutoCAD or similar software is an advantage but not required. 

 

• Experience with fiber optics, electrical installations, industrial environments or applicable safety standards is an advantage but not required.
